Disease association analysis


# 1. LDSC (pseudobulk)
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")

library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringi)
```

Prepare LDSC folders
  LDSC code and data
   - baselineLD_v2.2 (110 items)
   - ldsc-master
   - list.txt
   - plink_files (88 items)
   - w_hm3.snplist
   - weights (88 items)
  My data
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/bed", copy bed files to this directory
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/GWAS", copy GWAS sumstats (see below)
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/annot", empty
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/out", empty
   
## (1) prepare BED
```{r}
# cell type differential peak analysis result (from previous section, comparing 5 cell types)
load("./data_rda/Script3/ctMarkerPeaks_bulk.rda")

# get cell type marker peaks
ctPeaks <- getMarkers(ctMarkerPeaks_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6")
names(ctPeaks) <- stri_replace_all_regex(names(ctPeaks), pattern = c("Neuronal IPC","Radial glia"), 
                                         replacement = c("NIPC", "RG"), vectorize_all = FALSE)
for (x in names(ctPeaks)){
  name <- paste0("./data_input/LDSC_input/bed/",x,".bed")
  write.table(ctPeaks@listData[[x]][,c("seqnames","start","end")], name, 
              row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = '\t', quote = FALSE)
  rm(x, name)
}

rm(ctPeaks, ctMarkerPeaks_bulk)
gc()
```


## (2) munge sumstats
First, make sure the columns are names correctly
- rs ID: "SNP"
- sample size
  - For binary traits
    - column names: "N-cas"/"N-con" or "n_cases"/"n_controls"
    - if there are no N-cas/con information in the sumstats, add them while running ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py
  - For quantitative traits
    - use N 
```{bash}
conda activate ldsc
cd $HOME/Downloads/P1_EHB/data_input/LDSC
export data=$HOME/Downloads/P1_EHB/data_input/LDSC_input

# neurodevelopmental disorders ~ 20s each
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/ADHD_meta_Jan2022_iPSYCH1_iPSYCH2_deCODE_PGC.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_ADHD --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/iPSYCH-PGC_ASD_Nov2017.txt --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_ASD --N-cas 18382 --N-con 27969 --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/bip2024_eur_no23andMe.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_BP --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/daner_OCD_full_wo23andMe_190522.txt --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_OCD --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/PGC3_SCZ_wave3.european.autosome.public.v3.vcf.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_SCZ --a1-inc

# neurodegenerative disorders
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/GCST90027158_buildGRCh38.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_AD --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/GCST90275127.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_PD --N-cas 42792 --N-con 568693 --a1-inc

# other psychiatric conditions
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/ANX_2026_daner_fullANX_v12_woUTAH_11022026.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_ANX --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/g4_GWAS_Sumstats_Cleaned.txt --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_cogG4 --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/g6_GWAS_Sumstats_Cleaned.txt --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_cogG6 --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/pgc-mdd2025_no23andMe_eur_v3-49-24-11.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_MDD --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/GCST90726345.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_MDD1 --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/GCST90726346.tsv --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_MDD2 --a1-inc
```


## (3) make .annot files
```{bash}
#conda activate ldsc
#cd $HOME/Downloads/P1_EHB/data_input/LDSC
#export data=$HOME/Downloads/project_EHB/data_input/LDSC_input

celltypes=("Glioblast" "Neuroblast" "Neuron" "nIPC" "RG")

# automated parallel loop ~ 1.5 min [CPU intensive]
parallel -j 5 --bar '
  cell={1}
  for bimFile in plink_files/*.bim; do
    chr=$(echo "$bimFile" | cut -d "." -f 4)
    python ldsc-master/make_annot.py \
      --bed-file "${data}/bed/${cell}.bed" \
      --bimfile "$bimFile" \
      --annot-file "${data}/annot/${cell}.${chr}.annot"
  done
' ::: "${celltypes[@]}"
```


## (4) first-level LD score
Tutorial: https://github.com/bulik/ldsc/wiki/LD-Score-Estimation-Tutorial
          "Partitioned LD Scores >> Step 2"
This step summarizes *LD structure* in my data, and is *independent* of the GWAS result
The output MUST be stored in the same folder as the annot files!!
```{bash}
# automated parallel loop ~ 50 min [CPU intensive]
ls ${data}/annot/*.annot | parallel -j 8 --bar '
  annotFile={}
  chr=$(basename "$annotFile" | cut -d "." -f 2)
  celltype=$(basename "$annotFile" | cut -d "." -f 1)
  
  python ldsc-master/ldsc.py \
    --l2 --bfile plink_files/1000G.EUR.hg38.${chr} \
    --ld-wind-cm 1 \
    --annot "$annotFile" \
    --thin-annot \
    --out "${data}/annot/${celltype}.${chr}" \
    --print-snps list.txt
'
```


## (5) group-level LD score
Tutorial: https://github.com/bulik/ldsc/wiki/Partitioned-Heritability#cell-type-group-analysis
          "Cell-type group analysis"
```{bash}
# automated parallel loop for running LD baseline model ~ 50 min [CPU intensive]
ls ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/*.sumstats.gz | parallel -j 3 --bar '
  sumstats={}
  study=$(basename $sumstats | cut -d '/' -f 9 | cut -d '_' -f 2 | cut -d '.' -f 1)
  mkdir ${data}/out/${study}
  
  for sample in $(ls ${data}/annot | cut -d '.' -f 1 | uniq); do
    python ldsc-master/ldsc.py \
      --h2 $sumstats \
      --ref-ld-chr ${data}/annot/${sample}.,baselineLD_v2.2/baselineLD. \
      --w-ld-chr weights/weights.hm3_noMHC. \
      --frqfile-chr plink_files/1000G.EUR.hg38. \
      --out ${data}/out/${study}/${sample} \
      --print-coefficients \
      --overlap-annot
  done
'

# default: two sided LDSC test!
```


## (6) import results
```{r}
# import results
LDSC_results <- list()
for (folder in list.files("./data_input/LDSC_input/out", full.names = TRUE)){
  for (file in list.files(folder, pattern="\\.results$", full.names = TRUE)){
    disease <- sub("./data_input/LDSC_input/out/","",folder)
    table <- read.table(file, row.names=1)
    LDSC_results[[disease]] <- rbind(LDSC_results[[disease]], table[2,])
  }
  LDSC_results[[disease]][] <- lapply(LDSC_results[[disease]], as.numeric)
  names(LDSC_results[[disease]]) <- c("Prop._SNPs", "Prop._h2", "Prop._h2_std_error", "Enrichment", "Enrichment_std_error", "Enrichment_p", "Coefficient", "Coefficient_std_error", "Coefficient_z.score")
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_z.score))
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$GWAS <- disease
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$Test_group <- sub(".results","",list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.results$"))
  rm(folder, file, table, disease)
}

# formatting
LDSC_results <- do.call(rbind, LDSC_results)
row.names(LDSC_results) <- NULL
LDSC_results <- LDSC_results[,c(11:12,1:10)]
LDSC_results$Test_group <- stri_replace_all_regex(LDSC_results$Test_group, vectorize=FALSE, 
                                                  pattern=c('nIPC', 'RG'), replacement=c('Neuronal IPC', 'Radial glia'))
LDSC_results$Test_group <- factor(LDSC_results$Test_group, levels = c("Glioblast", "Radial glia","Neuronal IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))

# multiple testing correction, but too few passed BH correction, so just use nominal p < 0.05
LDSC_results$Coefficient_p_adj <- p.adjust(LDSC_results$Coefficient_p, method = "BH")

# significant results
LDSC_results$significant <- ""
LDSC_results$significant[LDSC_results$Coefficient_p <= 0.05 & LDSC_results$Enrichment > 1] <- "*"
```

### main fig - LDSC
```{r}
# select conditions
LDSC_results <- LDSC_results[LDSC_results$GWAS %ni% c("MDD1","MDD2"),]

# plotting
p <- list()
for (x in unique(LDSC_results$GWAS)){
  p[[x]] <- ggplot(LDSC_results[LDSC_results$GWAS==x,], aes(x=Test_group, y=Enrichment, fill=Test_group)) + 
    geom_col(color="black", position=position_dodge(),width=0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff", "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) +
    geom_text(aes(label=significant), position=position_dodge(width=0.9), vjust=0,size=5) +  
    theme_bw() + ggtitle(x) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))) + 
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") + labs(fill = "Cell type")
}

for (x in 1:length(p)){
  p[[x]] <- p[[x]] + theme(, )
  for (x in c(2:6,8:11)){
    p[[x]] <- p[[x]] + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, dpi=300}
gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = p, ncol = 6, left = textGrob("Enrichment (prop. h2 / prop. SNPs)", rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)))
```



# 2. SCAVENGE (single cell)
Tutorial: 
  https://sankaranlab.github.io/SCAVENGE/articles/SCAVENGE.html#trait-relevant-cell-determination-from-permutation-test
    Major changes I made to this pipeline: after running randomWalk_sparse(), I kept all cells instead of removing cells with np_score==0 (cells disconnected in the network), and assigned TRS = 0 to these cells.
  https://github.com/sankaranlab/SCAVENGE/wiki/%5BSCAVENGE%5D-Fine-mapping-analysis-of-GWAS-variants-prior-to-SCAVENGE-analysis
  https://github.com/sankaranlab/SCAVENGE/wiki/%5BSCAVENGE%5D-Preparing-your-scATAC-seq-data
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(SCAVENGE)
library(chromVAR)
library(gchromVAR)
library(BuenColors)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(BiocParallel)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(igraph)

library(ArchR)

```


## (1) GWAS fine-mapping
Tutorial: https://github.com/sankaranlab/SCAVENGE/wiki/%5BSCAVENGE%5D-Fine-mapping-analysis-of-GWAS-variants-prior-to-SCAVENGE-analysis

### [1] prepare sumstats
```{r}
# import raw GWAS sumstats ~ 1.5 min
sumstatsList <- list()
for (x in list.files("./data_input/LDSC_input/GWAS/sumstats_raw")){
  print(x)
  sumstatsList[[x]] <- fread(paste0("./data_input/LDSC_input/GWAS/sumstats_raw/",x))
  rm(x)
}
gc()

# GWAS study names
GWAS_studies <- read.delim("./data_input/LDSC_input/GWAS/GWAS_studies.txt")
names(sumstatsList) <- stri_replace_all_regex(names(sumstatsList), pattern = GWAS_studies$File, 
                                              replacement = GWAS_studies$Condition, vectorize_all = FALSE)
rm(GWAS_studies)
```

```{r}
## neurodevelopmental disorders

# ADHD
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$N <- sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$"N-cas" + sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$"N-con"
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$FREQ <- (sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$FRQ_A_38691 * sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$"N-cas" + 
                                  sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$FRQ_U_186843 * sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$"N-con") / sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$N
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$BETA <- log(sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$OR)
c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N") %in% names(sumstatsList[["ADHD"]])
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]] <- sumstatsList[["ADHD"]][, c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N")]

# ASD - sumstats doesn't include "FREQ" or "N" (for data privacy reasons)
SNP_frq <- data.frame()
for (x in list.files("./data_input/LDSC/plink_files", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.frq$")){
  frq <- as.data.frame(fread(x))
  SNP_frq <- rbind(SNP_frq, frq)
  rm(x, frq)
}
row.names(SNP_frq) <- SNP_frq$SNP
sumstatsList[["ASD"]] <- sumstatsList[["ASD"]][sumstatsList[["ASD"]]$SNP %in% SNP_frq$SNP,]
SNP_frq <- SNP_frq[sumstatsList[["ASD"]]$SNP,]
sumstatsList[["ASD"]]$FREQ <- SNP_frq$MAF # use frequency from European reference genome (PLINK files) as estimates for FREQ
sumstatsList[["ASD"]]$N <- 18382 + 27969
sumstatsList[["ASD"]]$BETA <- log(sumstatsList[["ASD"]]$OR)
c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N") %in% names(sumstatsList[["ASD"]])
sumstatsList[["ASD"]] <- sumstatsList[["ASD"]][, c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N")]
rm(SNP_frq)
gc()

# BP
names(sumstatsList[["BP"]])[names(sumstatsList[["BP"]])=="HRC_FRQ_A1"] <- "FREQ"
sumstatsList[["BP"]]$N <- sumstatsList[["BP"]]$"N-cas" + sumstatsList[["BP"]]$"N-con"
sumstatsList[["BP"]]$BETA <- log(sumstatsList[["BP"]]$OR)
c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N") %in% names(sumstatsList[["BP"]])
sumstatsList[["BP"]] <- sumstatsList[["BP"]][, c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N")]

# OCD
sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$N <- sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$"N-cas" + sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$"N-con"
sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$FREQ <- (sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$FRQ_A_23493 * sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$"N-cas" + 
                                  sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$FRQ_U_1114613 * sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$"N-con") / sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$N
sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$BETA <- log(sumstatsList[["OCD"]]$OR)
c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N") %in% names(sumstatsList[["OCD"]])
sumstatsList[["OCD"]] <- sumstatsList[["OCD"]][, c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N")]

# SCZ
sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$N <- sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$"N-cas" + sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$"N-con"
sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$FREQ <- (sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$FCAS * sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$"N-cas" + 
                                  sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$FCON * sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$"N-con") / sumstatsList[["SCZ"]]$N
names(sumstatsList[["SCZ"]])[names(sumstatsList[["SCZ"]])=="PVAL"] <- "P"
c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N") %in% names(sumstatsList[["SCZ"]])
```

```{r}
# export SNPs passing p-value filters for COJO 
# - if exporting all SNPs, the COJO step could take 20+ hours for high-power studies generating millions of SNPs!
for (x in names(sumstatsList)){
  sumstat_fil <- sumstatsList[[x]][sumstatsList[[x]]$P < 1e-5,]
  write.table(sumstat_fil, file = paste0("./data_input/data_COJO/input/", x,".ma"), 
              sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)  
  rm(x)
}
```


### [2] GCTA-COJO
Tutorial: https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#COJO

Setup
  - download gcta Mac version from https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#Download
  - the first time running COJO would trigger a warning message that the mac has blocked this unknown software
  - open system settings - privacy & security - security, click on the warning about gcta64 and allow access

```{bash}
cd $HOME/Downloads/P1_EHB/data_input/data_COJO/gcta-1.94.4-macOS-arm64
export PLINK=$HOME/Downloads/P1_EHB/data_input/LDSC/plink_files

# run COJO for GWAS studies with moderate power (p cutoff = 1e-5) ~ 2.5 min
ls ../input/*.ma | parallel -j 8 --bar '
  sumstats={}
  disease=$(basename $sumstats | cut -d "/" -f 3 | cut -d "." -f 1)
  mkdir ../output/${disease}
  for chr in {1..22}; do
    ./gcta64 --bfile ${PLINK}/1000G.EUR.hg38.${chr} --maf 0.01 --cojo-file $sumstats --cojo-slct --cojo-p 1e-5 --out ../output/${disease}/chr${chr}
  done
'
```

```{r}
# import top SNPs
lead_snps_list <- list()
for (disease in list.files("./data_input/data_COJO/output")){
  lead_snps <- list()
  for (x in list.files(paste0("./data_input/data_COJO/output/", disease), pattern = "\\.jma.cojo", full.names = TRUE)){
    lead_snps[[x]] <- read.table(x, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)  
  }
  lead_snps <- do.call(rbind, lead_snps)
  row.names(lead_snps) <- NULL
  lead_snps_list[[disease]] <- lead_snps
  rm(x, disease, lead_snps)
}
```


### [3] FINEMAP
```{r}
# remove duplicated SNPs from sumstats list (ADHD, AD, PD sumstats have duplicates) ~ 2.5 min
load("./data_rda/Script4/sumstatsList.rda")
for (x in names(sumstatsList)){
  print(x)
  y <- length(unique(sumstatsList[[x]]$SNP)) == nrow(sumstatsList[[x]])
  if (y==FALSE){
    print("removing duplicates")
    sumstatsList[[x]] <- sumstatsList[[x]] %>% distinct(SNP, .keep_all=TRUE)  
  }
  rm(x,y)
}
```

```{r}
# get SNP positions ~ 10s
SNP_pos <- list()
for (x in list.files("./data_input/LDSC/plink_files", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.bim$")){
  SNP_pos[[x]] <- as.data.frame(fread(x, col.names = c("CHR", "SNP", "CM", "BP", "A1", "A2")))
  rm(x)
}
names(SNP_pos) <- sub("./data_input/LDSC/plink_files/1000G.EUR.hg38.","",names(SNP_pos))
names(SNP_pos) <- sub(".bim","",names(SNP_pos))
names(SNP_pos) <- paste0("chr",names(SNP_pos))
```

```{r}
# Finemapping for case-control traits ~ 7.5 min
finemapping <- list()
for (x in c("cogG4","cogG6")){
  print(x)
  for (i in 1:nrow(lead_snps_list[[x]])){
    print(i)
    chr <- paste0("chr", lead_snps_list[[x]][i,"Chr"])
    pos <- lead_snps_list[[x]][i,"bp"]
    nearby_snps <- SNP_pos[[chr]][SNP_pos[[chr]]$BP >=  pos - 500000 & SNP_pos[[chr]]$BP <= pos + 500000,]$SNP
    windows <- sumstatsList[[x]][sumstatsList[[x]]$SNP %in% nearby_snps,]
    windows <- windows %>% mutate(MAF = ifelse(FREQ>0.5, 1-FREQ, FREQ)) %>% filter(MAF>0.01) %>% filter(BETA!=0)
    
    if (nrow(windows) != 0){
      if (!x %in% c("cogG4","cogG6")){
        # ABF finemapping for *case-control* trait
        coloc_ds_input <- list(type="cc", pvalues=windows$P, N=windows$N, MAF=windows$MAF, beta=windows$BETA,
                               varbeta=(windows$SE^2), snp=windows$SNP)
      } else {
        # ABF finemapping for *quantitative* trait
        coloc_ds_input <- list(type="quant", pvalues=windows$P, N=windows$N, MAF=windows$MAF, beta=windows$BETA,
                               varbeta=(windows$SE^2), snp=windows$SNP)
      }
      out <- coloc::finemap.abf(coloc_ds_input)  
      
      # filter to a 95% credible set
      finemapping[[x]][[i]]  <- out %>%  filter(as.character(prior) == as.character(1e-04)) %>% arrange(-SNP.PP) %>%
        mutate(SNP.PP.cumsum = cumsum(SNP.PP)) %>% mutate(incl95cs = ifelse( round(SNP.PP.cumsum, 2) <= 0.95, TRUE, FALSE )) %>%
        mutate(LDsentinel = ifelse (snp == lead_snps_list[[x]][i,"SNP"], TRUE, FALSE)) %>% filter(incl95cs == TRUE)
    }
  }
  rm(x, i, chr, pos,nearby_snps, windows, coloc_ds_input, out)
}
```

```{r}
# combine result for each GWAS, remove duplicated SNPs, keeping the one with the highest posterior probability
for (x in names(finemapping)){
  if (length(finemapping[[x]])>0){
    finemapping[[x]] <- do.call(rbind, finemapping[[x]])
    finemapping[[x]] <- finemapping[[x]] %>% arrange(desc(SNP.PP)) %>% distinct(snp, .keep_all=TRUE) 
  }
  rm(x)
}
```


### -------- save --------
```{r}
# save finemapping
save(finemapping, file = "./data_rda/Script4/finemapping.rda")

# save SNP & PP info as .bed ~ 1 min
SNP_pos_full <- do.call(rbind, SNP_pos)
for (x in names(finemapping)){
  print(x)
  if (length(finemapping[[x]])>0){
    colnames(finemapping[[x]])[5] <- 'SNP'
    table <- finemapping[[x]][finemapping[[x]]$SNP %in% sumstatsList[[x]]$SNP, c('SNP','SNP.PP')]
    table <- merge(table,SNP_pos_full[,c("SNP","CHR","BP")],by='SNP')
    table$CHR <- paste0('chr',table$CHR)
    table$start <- table$BP-1
    table <- table[,c("CHR","start","BP",'SNP','SNP.PP')]
    write.table(table, paste0("./data_input/SCAVENGE_input/",x,".bed"), sep="\t",row.names = F,quote = F,col.names = F)
  }
  rm(x, table)
}

# clear environment
rm(list = ls())
gc()
```


## (2) SCAVENGE 
### [1] all peaks
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_EHB_5ct.rda")

# peak matrix ~ 3 min
addArchRThreads(6)
PeakMatrix_5ct <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchR_EHB_5ct, useMatrix = "PeakMatrix")

# construct m-knn graph ~ 2 min
lsi_mat <- ArchR_EHB_5ct@reducedDims@listData$Harmony_age@listData$matDR
lsi_mat <- lsi_mat[colnames(PeakMatrix_5ct),]
mutual_knn <- getmutualknn(lsimat = lsi_mat, num_k = 30)
sum(rownames(mutual_knn) == colnames(PeakMatrix_5ct)) == nrow(mutual_knn) # match cell order
rm(lsi_mat)
gc()
```

```{r}
# make SummarizedExperiment: 526880 peaks, 71250 cells
SE_all <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = assay(PeakMatrix_5ct)), 
                               rowRanges = rowRanges(PeakMatrix_5ct), 
                               colData = DataFrame(names = colnames(assay(PeakMatrix_5ct))))
rm(PeakMatrix_5ct)
gc()

# background peaks
SE_all <- addGCBias(SE_all, genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
SE_all_bg <- getBackgroundPeaks(SE_all, niterations=200)

# double check cell order
sum(rownames(mutual_knn) == colnames(SE_all)) == ncol(SE_all)
```

```{r}
# run SCAVENGE ~ 8.5 min
set.seed(100)
mono_mat_all <- list()
for (x in list.files("./data_input/SCAVENGE_input", full.names = TRUE)){
  disease <- sub(".bed","",sub("./data_input/SCAVENGE_input/","",x))
  print(disease)
  
  # gchromVAR analysis
  print("gchromVAR analysis...")
  SNP_PP <- importBedScore(rowRanges(SE_all), x, colidx = 5)
  SE_all_dev <- computeWeightedDeviations(SE_all, weights = SNP_PP, background_peaks = SE_all_bg)
  rm(SNP_PP)
  
  # processing z score
  print("processing z score...")
  z_score_mat <- data.frame(colData(SE_all), z_score=t(assays(SE_all_dev)[["z"]]) |> c())
  seed_idx <- seedindex(z_score = z_score_mat$z_score, percent_cut = 0.05) # using top 5% cells as seed
  scale_factor <- cal_scalefactor(z_score = z_score_mat$z_score, percent_cut = 0.01)
  rm(SE_all_dev)
  
  # network propagation
  print("network propagation...")
  np_score <- randomWalk_sparse(intM = mutual_knn, queryCells = rownames(mutual_knn)[seed_idx], gamma = 0.05)
  TRS <- capOutlierQuantile(x = np_score, q_ceiling = 0.95) |> max_min_scale()
  TRS <- TRS * scale_factor
  mono_mat_all[[disease]] <- data.frame(z_score_mat, seed_idx = seed_idx, np_score, TRS)
  
  rm(x, disease, z_score_mat, seed_idx, scale_factor, np_score, TRS)
}
```

```{r}
GWAS_studies <- read.delim("./data_input/LDSC_input/GWAS/GWAS_studies.txt")
```

#### main fig - ct-peaks
```{r}
# get proportions in each ct-region
sig_summary <- data.frame()
for (x in names(mono_mat_permu_ct)){
  sigCells <- mono_mat_permu_ct[[x]]$names[mono_mat_permu_ct[[x]]$true_cell_top_idx == TRUE]
  for (y in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctRegion)){
    a <- sum(ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames %in% sigCells & ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctRegion==y)
    b <- sum(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctRegion==y)
    sig_summary <- rbind(sig_summary, c(x,y,a,b,a/b))
  }
  rm(x, sigCells, a, b)
}
names(sig_summary) <- c("disease","ctRegion","sigCells","allCells","prop")
sig_summary$prop <- as.numeric(sig_summary$prop)
sig_summary$sigCells <- as.numeric(sig_summary$sigCells)
sig_summary$allCells <- as.numeric(sig_summary$allCells)

# significance
sig_summary$odds_ratio <- NA
sig_summary$p_value <- NA
sig_summary$FDR <- NA
for (x in unique(sig_summary$disease)){
  # compute odds ratio for each ct-Regoin proportion
  a <- sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$sigCells
  b <- sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$allCells - a
  c <- sum(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$sigCells) - a
  d <- sum(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$allCells) - sum(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$sigCells) - b
  sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$odds_ratio <- (a / b) / ( c / d)
  
  # perform two-sided hypergeometric test
  sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$p_value <- phyper(a-1, a+c, b+d, a+b, lower.tail = FALSE)
  sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$FDR <- p.adjust(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$p_value, method = "BH")
  
  rm(x,a,b,c,d)
}

# significant filters
sig_summary$text <- round(sig_summary$prop*100,1) # signficant cell proportion
sig_summary$text[sig_summary$FDR > 0.01] <- ""  # filter 1: FDR
sig_summary$text[sig_summary$odds_ratio < 2] <- "" # filter 2: odds ratio

# add cell type, region
sig_summary$celltype <- sub("_.*","",sig_summary$ctRegion)
sig_summary$region <- sub(".*_","",sig_summary$ctRegion)
sig_summary$region <- factor(sig_summary$region, levels = c("FB", "CP", "MD"))
sig_summary$celltype <- factor(sig_summary$celltype, levels = c("Glioblast", "RG","n-IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))

# add disorder group
sig_summary$group <- stri_replace_all_regex(sig_summary$disease, pattern = GWAS_studies$Condition, 
                                              replacement = GWAS_studies$Group, vectorize_all = FALSE)
sig_summary$disease <- factor(sig_summary$disease, levels=rev(GWAS_studies$Condition))
sig_summary_ct <-sig_summary

# select conditions
sig_summary_ct <- sig_summary_ct[sig_summary_ct$disease %ni% c("MDD1","MDD2"),]
```

```{r}
  # compute odds ratio for each ct-Regoin proportion
  a <- sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$sigCells
  b <- sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$allCells - a
  c <- sum(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$sigCells) - a
  d <- sum(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$allCells) - sum(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$sigCells) - b
  sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$odds_ratio <- (a / b) / ( c / d)
  
  # perform two-sided hypergeometric test
  sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$p_value <- phyper(a-1, a+c, b+d, a+b, lower.tail = FALSE)
  sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$FDR <- p.adjust(sig_summary[sig_summary$disease==x,]$p_value, method = "BH")
  
  rm(x,a,b,c,d)
}

# significant filters
sig_summary$text <- round(sig_summary$prop*100,1) # signficant cell proportion
sig_summary$text[sig_summary$FDR > 0.01] <- ""  # filter 1: FDR
sig_summary$text[sig_summary$odds_ratio < 2] <- "" # filter 2: odds ratio

# add cell type, region
sig_summary$celltype <- sub("_.*","",sig_summary$ctRegion)
sig_summary$region <- sub(".*_","",sig_summary$ctRegion)
sig_summary$region <- factor(sig_summary$region, levels = c("FB", "CP", "MD"))
sig_summary$celltype <- factor(sig_summary$celltype, levels = c("Glioblast", "RG","n-IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))

# add disorder group
sig_summary$group <- stri_replace_all_regex(sig_summary$disease, pattern = GWAS_studies$Condition, 
                                              replacement = GWAS_studies$Group, vectorize_all = FALSE)
sig_summary$disease <- factor(sig_summary$disease, levels=rev(GWAS_studies$Condition))
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
# TRS UMAP
p <- list()
# select conditions
for (x in names(mono_mat_ct)[names(mono_mat_ct) %ni% c("MDD1","MDD2")]){
  # calculate standardised TRS (z transformation)
  TRS <- mono_mat_ct[[x]]
  TRS$TRS_norm <- as.vector(scale(TRS$TRS))

  # prapare data for UMAP
  umap <- ArchR_EHB_5ct@embeddings@listData[["UMAP"]]@listData[["df"]]
  names(umap) <- c("umap1","umap2")
  umap$cell <- row.names(umap)
  transfer <- merge(umap, TRS, by.x = "cell", by.y = "names")
  
  # UMAP (can choose between TRS and TRS_norm)
  p <- append(p, list(ggplot(transfer, aes(umap1,umap2,colour=TRS_norm)) + 
    geom_point(size = 0.01) + theme_classic() + ggtitle(x) + coord_equal() +
    scale_colour_gradientn(breaks = seq(-1, 2, 1), limits = c(-1.5, 2.6), 
                           colours = c("#badbff","#d1e7ff","#dce9f7","#ebf2fa","#f5f7fa","white",
                                       "#FFFFCC","#FED976","#FEB255","#FC6622","#EE2211","#CC0022","#990000")) +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
          plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0,0.5,0),"cm"), legend.position="none")))
  
  # prepare data for bar plot, split into celltype-region groups
  transfer <- data.frame(cell = ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames, ctRegion = ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctRegion)
  transfer <- merge(transfer, TRS, by.x = "cell", by.y = "names")
  transfer$celltype <- sub("_.*","",transfer$ctRegion)
  transfer$region <- sub(".*_","",transfer$ctRegion)
  transfer <- transfer[order(transfer$celltype, transfer$region),]
  transfer$region <- factor(transfer$region, levels = c("FB","CP","MD"))
  transfer$celltype <- factor(transfer$celltype, levels = c("Glioblast", "RG","n-IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))
  
  # significant groups - based on (1) hypergeometric test after permutation (2) odds ratio > 1.5
  significance <- sig_summary_ct[sig_summary_ct$disease==x,]
  significance$sig <- significance$tex
  significance$sig[significance$sig!=""] <- "*"
  significance$position <- max(transfer$TRS_norm) + 0.05
  
  # box plot 
  p <- append(p, list(
    ggplot(transfer,aes(x=celltype, y=TRS_norm))  +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = celltype), outlier.shape=NA) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    pretty_plot(fontsize = 15) + facet_wrap(~region) + 
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FB" = 1, "CP" = 0.75, "MD" = 0.5)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff","n-IPC" = "#40a1ff", RG="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 13), legend.position="none") +
    geom_text(data = significance, aes(x = celltype, y = position, label = sig), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1))) 

  rm(x, TRS, umap, transfer, significance)
}
```
